name: Leftwitch's Package
summary: Leftwitch’s Package carries the last piece of Reclaimers Inc.’s business in Desolace back to Ironforge. Roetten Stonehammer receives it and pays for the work.

sections.title: Back to Ironforge
sections.body: Roetten Stonehammer waits in Ironforge for Leftwitch’s Package from Desolace. Carry it back to him, and Reclaimers Inc. will pay for this final piece of work. Roetten is glad to have you aboard, even for a small job.

faq.answer: Roetten Stonehammer in Ironforge receives Leftwitch’s Package on Leftwitch’s behalf.
Take Leftwitch’s Package from Desolace to Roetten Stonehammer in Ironforge.

faq.q: What is the package connected to?
faq.answer: Leftwitch’s Package is the final delivery in Reagents for Reclaimers Inc.’s business in Desolace.

faq.q: What does Roetten do when he gets it?
faq.answer: Roetten thanks you for the timely work and pays you on behalf of Reclaimers Inc.
